items.heading: If You Searched for Career
items.text: If You Searched for Career If You Searched for Career If you searched for career choices after 12th, a career path after 12th, or simply "what should I do now", you are asking one question in different words: which door should I walk through, and what does it cost if I am wrong?

items.heading: How Many Students Does IT
items.text: How Many Students Does IT How many students does it count? A placement report that covers only placed students hides everyone who did not get an offer.

items.heading: We Ordered These
items.text: We ordered these by how much real headroom each has for income and options over time, not by prestige. That means the lanes that reward proof and scalable skill come first, and licensed or exam-led lanes come after, because their pay is more structured and their entry filters are tougher.

rows: About 20,00,000 appeared; 11,21,000 qualified; 1,36,939 MBBS seats on the NMC matrix of 22 July 2026, of which 63,296 are government seats
Qualifying is not the same as getting a seat. Price a private MBBS seat, or an allied-health and BSc plan, before results.
JEE Main to an IIT seat
15,38,468 unique candidates appeared in Main; 18,826 IIT seats
A good Main score is not an IIT plan. It is an NIT, IIIT, or state-college plan unless Advanced also goes well.
JEE Advanced to an IIT seat
Even after qualifying, about two in three qualifiers do not get an IIT seat, so rank, branch, and college are traded off in counselling.
JEE Main rank alone (NITs, IIITs, other government-funded institutes)
48,372 of the 67,323 JoSAA seats (25,162 NIT, 11,518 IIIT, 11,692 other institutes) need only a Main rank
Most engineering seats on the central list never needed Advanced. State counselling adds more seats on top.

items.heading: Is IT Median or Top
items.text: Is it median or top? A top package describes one student. The median describes the middle of the class.

items.heading: What Stage Is IT
items.text: What stage is it? Starting pay, year five, and senior pay are three different numbers.

items.heading: Which Employer Type
items.text: Which employer type? A product company, a service company, a start-up, a government body, and a family firm pay differently.

items.heading: What Did IT Cost
items.text: What did it cost to get there? Subtract fees, loan interest, and years without income before you call a path "high paying".
